name: site-architecture
description: Plan a website's information architecture: a page tree where every page has exactly one parent, URL rules, navigation labels and breadcrumbs; a link plan computed from a links export (source and target) that uses only your own URLs and shows click depth before and after; hub page and child page link specs; which filter URLs get indexable pages, with the URL count worked out; and a redirect map checked for chains, loops and homepage targets for URL changes and site moves. Not a search audit and not software architecture.
